summary: A testimonial styled as a monospace thermal receipt with notched edges.
purpose: Show social proof in the Digital Noir voice. Reach for it to present a quote with an author, role, and timestamp as a receipt or terminal log.

anatomy.description: The dashed-border glass panel with notched top and bottom edges.
A receipt id and a timestamp along the top.
Author name and role below a dashed divider.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: A time label shown in the meta row.

whenToUse: Presenting a testimonial or social proof on a marketing surface.
Any short quote that fits the receipt or terminal-log motif.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Showing a functional, checkable plan or log
A generic quote outside the receipt motif

do: Keep the quote to a sentence or two.
Provide a real author and role for credibility.
dont: Put interactive controls inside; it is a display element.
Use it for functional logs the user acts on.

content.voice: Dry, deadpan testimonial; the UnmessMe satire.
rules: Quote is one to two sentences.

aria: The quote should read as a blockquote to assistive tech.
accessibility.contrast: Quote text holds at least 4.5:1; the meta row is decorative and may be lower.

examples.title: Testimonial
examples.code: <TerminalReceipt text="UnmessMe turned the fire into a very nice spreadsheet." author="Sarah J." role="Creative Director" timestamp="10:42 PM" />

related.whenToChoose: PlanStepList is a functional, checkable log; TerminalReceipt is a static testimonial.
